text: How a check reads: only a true condition passes, and a comparison with a missing value is not true.
Input checks run before any rule, on the document the mapping reads; Output checks run after the last rule, on the one it wrote.
Check the document against the mapping's JSON Schema.
A check of your own: an expression on $ that must be true, a code and a message for the report, and what to do when it is not: reject (no rule runs, no output) or warn.
